changes: Added a convergence + takeover circuit breaker: core/convergence-breaker.ts derives four cheap read-only per-story signals (advance-count, review pass-rate, takeover frequency, repeated-identical-gate-failure) and hard-stops story_advance on a pathological signature; one-shot auto-recovery re-baselines ALL signals, then a re-trip freezes with a human-only story_resume ack refused under autopilot/non-interactive. Takeover + gate-failure counters bump at existing write sites; state is gitignored.
usage: Runs automatically at the story_advance choke point. Tune via LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_ADVANCE (20) / MAX_TAKEOVER (5) / MIN_PASS_RATE (0.35) / MIN_SAMPLE (10) / MAX_GATE_REPEAT (2). A frozen story is cleared by an interactive human: lattice story_resume --storyId=<id> --ack --reason=<why>.
expectedOutcome: A runaway story (B-f458 signature: 89 advances / 131:31 review / 65 takeovers) is hard-blocked at story_advance with a message naming the tripped counters and the resume command; a healthy 6-10-advance story is never frozen.
actualTranscript: npm run test:convergence-breaker prints PASS across 15 sections; real-CLI: a frozen story_advance was rejected before the checklist gate with the tripped-counter freeze message; story_resume was refused in a non-interactive session; git check-ignore confirms the three runtime files are ignored.
outcomeDiff: expected vs actual: identical — the storm signature trips all four reasons and freezes on re-trip; the healthy control never trips; the ack refuses non-interactively; runtime state stays gitignored. No divergence.
limitations: The human-ack presence check (env markers + stdin.isTTY) blocks accidental unattended self-ack but is not proof against a deliberately adversarial caller that allocates a pseudo-TTY (documented accepted-risk; un-spoofable presence would need an out-of-band channel). One low-severity cleanup deferred: resumeBreakerState has an unused priorState param (follow-up task filed).
pitfalls: Every material change re-stales verificationEvidence pins and reviewer passes — run recover_evidence (not just refresh_stale) to rebind after any code edit. The gate-failure reset is scoped to successful story_advance ONLY (not any mutation) so a runaway cannot defeat gate-repeat via a no-op success. Never derive a story path from a non-canonical storyId (isCanonicalStoryId guards all three counter/gate sites).
